classic.name: Classic
classic.title: Guess today's Persona character!
classic.subtitle: Type any character to start.
classic.goal_text: Guess the Persona character of the day using deduction and clues 🧩🕵️.
classic.rule_1: Each attempt shows how close your guess is to the correct character.
classic.rule_2: A grid compares multiple attributes like game, gender, age, arcana, etc.
classic.rule_3: 🟩 Green = correct, 🟨 Yellow = partial match, 🟥 Red = wrong.
classic.criteria_game: 🎮 Game – Which Persona game they appear in
classic.criteria_persona_user: 💥 Persona User / Shadow – Can they use a Persona or are they a Shadow?
classic.criteria_persona: 👺 Persona – The specific Persona or Shadow form
classic.criteria_arcana: 🃏 Arcana – Their Tarot Arcana (Fool, Magician, etc.)
classic.tip_1: 🧠 Use deduction based on color-coded clues.
classic.tip_2: 📈 If the age isn't exact, an arrow ↑ or ↓ appears.
classic.tip_3: 🟨 Yellow means partial match (e.g. same series but different game).
classic.daltonian_desc: 🌈 Daltonian Mode – Replaces red/green/yellow with colorblind-friendly shades and adds symbols (✔, ▲, ✖) for better clarity.
classic.flow_input: ⌨️ Type a name and select from suggestions.
classic.flow_hint: 💬 At 3 attempts: 🔓 Hint unlocks (displays a quote).
classic.flow_giveup: ❌ At 8 attempts: 🔓 Give Up unlocks (reveals the answer).
classic.spoiler_desc: 🕹️ Use the filter buttons to limit characters by game.
classic.spoiler_help: 👀 This helps avoid spoilers if you haven't played them all!
classic.closing: 🎭 Think like a Phantom Thief... and unveil the truth!
classic.not_in_database: "{{name}}" does not exist in the database!
classic.tooltip_name: The full name of the character as known in the Persona universe.
classic.tooltip_game: The game(s) in which this character appears: P3, P4G, P5, PQ2, etc.
classic.tooltip_gender: Represents the character's identity — Human, Artificial, Shadow, or Entity.
classic.tooltip_age: Age range from "< 15" to "40+", including unique entities like "80+".
classic.tooltip_persona_user: Indicates if the character can summon a Persona or is a Shadow.
classic.tooltip_persona: The specific Persona linked to the character — or their Shadow form.
classic.tooltip_arcana: Their Tarot Arcana, which defines their symbolic and narrative role.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.title: Which character do these emojis describe?
emoji.subtitle: Each try unlocks an emoji.
emoji.goal_text: Guess which Persona character is being described by a sequence of emojis 🤔📱.
emoji.rule_1: 💬 You start with 1 emoji to describe the character.
emoji.rule_2: ❌ Each wrong guess unlocks 1 more emoji.
emoji.rule_3: ✅ Once you find the right character, the full emoji chain is revealed 🎉.
emoji.tip_1: 🧩 Emojis may refer to: personality, arcana, story events, role, or weapon.
emoji.tip_2: 📘 Example: 🗡️⚡😐 might describe a serious character with a sword and lightning.
emoji.tip_3: 🔍 Try to guess based on context, not just literal emoji meanings!
emoji.flow_input: ⌨️ Type a character's name and choose from the suggestions.
emoji.flow_giveup: 🆘 Give Up button unlocks after 8 attempts.
emoji.spoiler_desc: 🎮 Use the filters to limit characters by game.
emoji.spoiler_help: 🙈 This helps avoid spoilers if you haven't played every game yet!
emoji.closing: ✨ Let your intuition guide you... and read between the emojis 🧠📲
emoji.giveup_reveal: You gave up! The answer was: {{name}}

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.title: Guess today's Persona character from their silhouette!
silhouette.subtitle: Type any name to start 👤
silhouette.goal_intro: A shadowy figure stands before you...
silhouette.goal_question: Can you identify the Persona character just from their black silhouette?
silhouette.rule_1: 🔍 The game starts with a heavily zoomed-in silhouette.
silhouette.rule_2: ❌ Every wrong guess zooms the image out, revealing more of the outline.
silhouette.rule_3: ✅ Find the right name, and the full portrait is revealed!
silhouette.tip_1: 🧍 Pay attention to the silhouette's pose, hairstyle, weapon, or accessories.
silhouette.tip_2: 👓 Some characters have distinct stances or iconic features — spot them!
silhouette.tip_3: 🎮 Use your knowledge from all Persona games and spin-offs.
silhouette.giveup_unlock: 🆘 The Give Up button unlocks after 5 failed attempts.
silhouette.giveup_penalty: 🙈 You'll see the answer — but it counts as a loss!
silhouette.games_list: Characters from Persona 1, 2 (IS & EP), 3, 4, 5 and P5: The Phantom X including spin-offs.
silhouette.closing: 🧠 Observe the shadows, trust your instincts, and become the ultimate silhouette detective!

alloutattack.name: All-Out Attack
alloutattack.title: Guess today's Persona character!
alloutattack.subtitle: Type any character to start.
alloutattack.goal_text: Guess the Persona character based on their All-Out Attack animation.
alloutattack.gameplay_1: You start with a blurry All-Out Attack GIF.
alloutattack.gameplay_2: Each incorrect guess reduces the blur.
alloutattack.gameplay_3: Try to guess with the fewest attempts possible!
alloutattack.games_list: Only characters from Persona 3 Reload, Persona 5 / Royal and Persona 5: The Phantom X.
alloutattack.giveup_unlock: After 5 incorrect guesses, the Give Up button activates.
alloutattack.closing: Let your eyes adjust, focus your instincts, and go for the critical hit!
alloutattack.giveup_reveal: ❌ You gave up! The answer was: {{name}}
alloutattack.no_characters: No characters available with current filters.

personae.name: Personae
personae.title: Guess the Persona User from their Personae!
personae.subtitle: Type a name to start 💥
personae.goal_intro: A mysterious Persona appears on screen...
personae.goal_question: Your mission? Guess who it belongs to!
personae.rule_1: 🖼️ A Persona is displayed — observe its design, motifs, and style.
personae.rule_2: 👤 Enter the name of the character you believe is the rightful user.
personae.rule_3: ✅ If correct, the result is revealed and counted as a win!
personae.tip_1: 🎨 Persona designs often reflect their user's personality, backstory, or arcana.
personae.tip_2: 🔄 Some Personae are shared by multiple characters — context is everything!
personae.tip_3: 📖 Use your lore knowledge from Persona 2, 3, 4, 5 and spin-offs.
personae.giveup_unlock: 🔁 After 3 failed attempts, the Give Up button becomes available.
personae.giveup_penalty: 🆘 Clicking it reveals the correct character — but counts as a loss.
personae.games_list: Personae from P2 (IS & EP), P3, P4, P5, P5X and their respective spin-offs.
personae.closing: 🔍 Trust your insight, rely on your memory, and prove your Persona mastery!

music_master.name: Music Master

into_the_fog.name: Unsolved Case

into_the_fog.description: The train departs, but the mystery remains. You chose the path of ignorance, leaving the true culprit smiling in the shadows.

velvet_headache.name: Velvet Headache
velvet_headache.condition: Find Wonder (Velvet) and Caroline & Justine in All-Out Attack
velvet_headache.description: So loud... The sisters are fighting, and the guest has a migraine. You've witnessed the true chaos of the Velvet Room.

first_win.name: First Victory
first_win.description: The first step on your journey as a Persona user. A wild card has awakened within you.

p1_p2_fan.name: Echoes of the Past
p1_p2_fan.description: You've walked the same path as Naoya, Tatsuya, and Maya. The legacy of the first awakened lives on through you.

velvet_master.name: Velvet Master
velvet_master.description: You have mastered the Velvet Room. Igor is pleased with your progress.

chinese_new_year.name: Chinese New Year
chinese_new_year.condition: Find Wonder and Rin (CNY) in All-Out Attack
chinese_new_year.description: Celebration time! You discovered the festive versions of the Phantom Thieves.

twin_blade.name: Twin Blade
twin_blade.condition: Find the Personae of Yosuke and Yusuke
twin_blade.description: Wind and Ice, blades crossed! You've identified the personas of the dual-wielding artists.

persona_q_explorer.name: Cinema Explorer
persona_q_explorer.condition: Find all 4 Persona Q exclusive characters in Silhouette mode
persona_q_explorer.description: You've ventured into the cinema's labyrinth and met its unique guardians. Rei, Zen, Hikari, and Nagi — all discovered in the shadows!

crimson_legacy.name: Crimson Legacy
crimson_legacy.description: Awarded to the Trickster who recognizes the past painted in red. You identified the rebellious spirits of legends reborn.

rentree.name: Spring Awakening
rentree.description: Cherry blossoms bloom as a new school year begins. You've entered the Velvet Room on Japan's opening ceremony day.

take_the_pose.name: Take The Pose
take_the_pose.description: Strike a pose! You've shared your PersonaDLE journey with the world.

christmas_2025.name: Christmas 2025
christmas_2025.description: Celebrate the holidays with PersonaDLE! May your New Year be full of All-Out Attacks!

new_years_2026.name: New Year's 2026
new_years_2026.condition: Redeem the New Year 2026 event code
new_years_2026.description: Ring in the new year with style! Here's to another year of unveiling the truth.

chinese_new_year_2026.name: Happy Chinese New Year 2026
chinese_new_year_2026.condition: Redeem the Chinese New Year 2026 code
chinese_new_year_2026.description: Ryuji & Wu Kong ready for the new year! May the year of the horse bring you strength and courage!

valentine_2026.name: Valentine's Day 2026
valentine_2026.description: A Social Link deepened! Love is in the air, just like a max rank romance.

easter_2026.name: Easter 2026
easter_2026.description: Hunt for easter eggs like you hunt for Personas! Spring brings new beginnings.

github_contributor.name: Phantom Coder
github_contributor.description: You checked the source code! A true Phantom Thief always gathers intel first.

true_hacker.name: True Hacker
true_hacker.description: You cracked the code! Futaba would be proud of your hacking skills.

tae_takemi.name: Tae Takemi Fan
tae_takemi.description: Support your local punk doctor! The Death confidant rewards the faithful.

dzulian.name: The First Contractor
dzulian.description: When the code couldn't reach the PS1 era, Dzulian descended with the ancient texts. Megami Ibunroku, IS, EP — the trinity preserved. The GOAT who bridged two generations of Persona.

true_confidant.name: True Confidant
true_confidant.condition: Reach Social Link Rank 10 with a friend
true_confidant.description: An unbreakable bond forged through shared victories and defeats. A badge for two — proof that your friendship transcends the Metaverse.

sport.name: Athletic Spirit
sport.condition: Redeem code 'SPORT' between April 6th and May 1st, 2025
sport.description: Like the sports teams of Gekkoukan, Yasogami, and Shujin, you've answered the call on International Sports Day!

arati.name: Arati's Blessing
arati.description: Recognized by a true Persona content creator! You're part of the community now.

chef.name: Master Chef
chef.description: Sojiro's curry, Nanako's cooking... You appreciate the finer culinary arts of Persona!

lobster.name: Artistic Lobster
lobster.description: Magnificent! The contours, the form... This crustacean captures the very essence of beauty! I must paint this immediately!

hippocampus_reload.name: Hippocampus Reload
hippocampus_reload.condition: Find the ZUTOMAYO x P3R Mashup in Music mode
hippocampus_reload.description: Brainwaves synced! You found the chaotic mashup where growing pains meet mass destruction. The memory of this beat will never fade.

truth_duality.name: Truth & Duality
truth_duality.condition: Find both Crow and Black Mask in All-Out Attack mode
truth_duality.description: Two sides of the same coin. The pleasant boy and the black mask... Both faces of justice revealed.

one_shot.name: Critical Strike
one_shot.condition: Guess correctly on the very first try
one_shot.description: Why waste time with strategy when you can just smash through? Awarded for a flawless first guess, striking the truth with the raw, unstoppable force of a one-hit KO.

aoa_vision.name: Piercing the Fog
aoa_vision.condition: Guess the All-Out Attack on the very first try
aoa_vision.description: The truth was shrouded in heavy fog, yet you didn't even need glasses to see the big picture. Awarded for instantly recognizing the All-Out Attack through the blinding static.

emoji_decoder.name: Emoji Decoder
emoji_decoder.description: The Metaverse speaks a wordless language, a cacophony of cryptic symbols. With royal finesse, you deciphered the code of the digital soul.

navigator.name: Eye of the Navigator
navigator.condition: Use the hint 50 times in Classic mode
navigator.description: Fifty anomalies scanned and deciphered. No truth can hide from your radar.

velvet_regular.name: Velvet Regular
velvet_regular.description: Fifty days between mind and matter. The master of this room now recognizes your footsteps.

strega.name: Apostles of the Fall
strega.condition: Find Hypnos (Takaya), Moros (Jin) and Medea (Chidori) in Personae mode
strega.description: Why fight the inevitable? The world is a stage for the final act. We are simply the directors of your beautiful destruction.

twin_fist.name: Twin Fist
twin_fist.condition: Find a Persona of Makoto Nijima and Akihiko in Personae mode
twin_fist.description: Nuclear force and crackling lightning! You've identified the personas of the two fiercest brawlers who lead with their knuckles.

twin_spear.name: Twin Spear
twin_spear.condition: Find a Persona of Kotone and Ken in Personae mode
twin_spear.description: One seeks vengeance through light, the other leads with a dancing blade. You've found the spear-wielding duo of the Moonlight Bridge.

tradition_modernite.name: Chronological Convergence
tradition_modernite.condition: Find Naoto's & Futaba's personas + 'Secret Base' & 'When Mother Was There' in Music mode
tradition_modernite.description: Two minds, a century apart, now perfectly synchronized in the infinite search for truth. Tradition and innovation are one.

shapeshifter.name: The Formless Soul
shapeshifter.condition: Guess the same character in 3 different modes (cumulative)
shapeshifter.description: A mask may change, and the stage may shift, but the true self remains constant. Awarded to those who can pierce the cognitive distortions and recognize a single soul across three different realities.

ideal_reality.name: Gentle Illusion
ideal_reality.condition: Give up when the target is 'Our Light' in Music mode
ideal_reality.description: Why struggle to reach the light when happiness can be given to you? You laid down your rebellious soul to embrace a painless, perfect dream.

for_real.name: For Real
for_real.condition: Find Ryuji's All-Out Attack in AOA mode and his persona in Personae mode
for_real.description: YEAH! That's what I'm talking about! You found the most passionate Phantom Thief — both his Persona and his signature All-Out Attack!

night_owl.name: Phantom of the Night
night_owl.condition: Play between midnight and 5 AM (Paris time)
night_owl.description: True thieves operate under the cover of darkness. The cognitive world is yours.

nyx_hour.name: Nyx Hour
nyx_hour.condition: Play between midnight and 12:30 AM (Paris time)
nyx_hour.description: The clock strikes twelve, but tomorrow never comes. You have witnessed the arrival of the end.

stylist.name: Breathtaking Aesthetics
stylist.condition: Customize your profile: avatar + UI color + 1 badge selected + profile music
stylist.description: Such passion! Such composition! You refused the mediocrity of a default profile to forge a visual masterpiece that moves the very soul.

pyro_spark.name: The Ignition
pyro_spark.description: A tiny flicker in the dark. For seven days, you've kept the flame alive. The first step towards a scorching resolve.

raphael.name: The Divine Blaze
raphael.description: Thirty days. The flicker has ascended into a roaring inferno. Your resolve now burns with a heat that even the abyss cannot cool.

surt.name: Ragnarök's Dawn
surt.description: Ninety days of absolute, unrelenting persistence. You have summoned the world-ending fire of Surt. The old world of hesitation has been incinerated.

lucifer.name: Crest of the Morning Star
lucifer.description: One hundred and twenty sunrises. Beyond the fires of destruction lies the blinding clarity of the Morning Star. You have seized ultimate dominion over time itself.

helel.name: The Eternal Zenith
helel.description: Beyond rebellion, beyond ruin, lies the pure grace of the first star. You have walked the path for a year, reaching a state of perfection that even the gods envy.

reborn_phoenix.name: Phoenix Reborn
reborn_phoenix.condition: Restore your streak after losing it (grace period)
reborn_phoenix.description: A momentary lapse in the flow of time! You refused to let the darkness claim your legacy. From the scattered ashes of yesterday, you soar toward a new dawn.

best_bro.name: Best Bro
best_bro.description: The bonds of friendship transcend time and fate. You've found your allies in the velvet web of connections.

data_mining.name: Data Mining
data_mining.description: Analyzing the competition or seeking new bonds? You've peered into the souls of five different users.

leblanc_meeting.name: Leblanc Meeting
leblanc_meeting.condition: 3 or more friends logged in the same day as you
leblanc_meeting.description: Synchronized souls! You and your closest allies have converged. Even the busiest Phantom Thief needs a coffee break.

golden_week.name: Golden Week
golden_week.condition: Log in between April 29 and May 5
golden_week.description: Even truth-seekers need a break. You spent the golden holidays forging bonds under the evening sun.

tanabata.name: Tanabata
tanabata.description: The stars align for a single night. Your wish has been recorded in the celestial archives of the Sea of Souls.

promised_day.name: The Promised Day
promised_day.description: The clock strikes twelve on the dying year. You faced the threshold of the new dawn without blinking.

hifumi_archives.name: The Grandmaster's Tome
hifumi_archives.description: A true tactician studies the board before striking. You've uncovered the hidden reports.

report.name: The Priestess's Audit
report.description: Channeling the meticulous wisdom of the High Priestess, you've documented the anomalies. Awarded to those who bear the heavy burden of paperwork to keep the system's chaos in check.

privacy.intro: PersonaDLE is a free fan-made guessing game. Here's everything you need to know about your data — no lawyer-speak.
privacy.collected_email: Your email address — to create and secure your account
privacy.collected_pseudo: A username of your choice — displayed on your profile
privacy.collected_stats: Your game statistics — wins, streaks, attempts, time played
privacy.collected_avatar: An avatar image — only if you choose to upload one
privacy.collected_prefs: Your preferences — language, dark mode, theme, badges
privacy.never_ads: Use it for advertising or profiling
privacy.never_money: Monetize anything — PersonaDLE is and will always be free
privacy.security_bcrypt: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt — we literally cannot read them.
privacy.security_cookie: Sessions use secure, first-party cookies only — no tracking.
privacy.security_https: The site runs on HTTPS in production.
privacy.retention_body: Your data is kept as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time from your profile page — this triggers immediate anonymization followed by permanent deletion within 30 days.
privacy.rights_access: Right of access — request a copy of your data
privacy.rights_rectify: Right to rectification — update your profile (pseudo, avatar, preferences) directly in the app; to correct your email address, contact us below
privacy.rights_delete: Right to deletion — use the "Delete my account" button in your profile
privacy.rights_portability: Right to portability — export your local profile data with the "Export" button, or contact us below for a full copy of your account data
privacy.cookies_body: We use 3 strictly necessary technical cookies, all first-party: a session cookie (httpOnly, secure) to keep you logged in, an optional "remember me" cookie (httpOnly, secure, 30 days) if you choose to stay logged in, and a security cookie (secure, readable only by the page's own script — not httpOnly by design) that protects your account actions from forgery. No advertising cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts.
privacy.contact_body: For any questions about your data or to exercise your rights:

faq.a1: PersonaDLE is a free daily fan-made guessing game based on the Persona RPG series (P1 → P5X). Every day, a new character, Persona or music track is chosen — you have a limited number of attempts to find it across 6 different game modes.
faq.a2: Characters and content from Persona 1, 2, 3 (+ FES, Portable, Reload), 4 (+ Golden, Arena Ultimax), 5 (+ Royal, Strikers, Tactica), Persona 5X, and Persona Q (+ Q2). Coverage grows with each new release.
faq.q3: How often does the game reset?
faq.a3: Every day at midnight Paris time. Each of the 6 modes resets independently with a fresh target.
faq.a4: 100% free, forever. No ads, no in-app purchases. If you enjoy the game, Ko-fi donations help cover server costs — but they are never required.
faq.q5: How many game modes are there?
faq.a5: 6 modes — Classic (Wordle-style attribute grid), Emoji (decode emoji clues), Silhouette (progressive image reveal), All-Out Attack (animated GIF), Personae (guess from the Persona, not the character), and Music (short audio excerpt).
faq.a6: Type a character name. After each guess, a grid compares 7 attributes: name, game of origin, gender, age, whether they're a Persona user or a Shadow, their Persona, and their Arcana. Green = exact match, yellow = close, red = wrong — same logic as Wordle.
faq.a7: There are actually two streaks. Your per-mode streak (shown on each mode's page) counts consecutive days you've won in that specific mode — it resets to 0 if you miss a day or don't win, including giving up. Your global streak (shown on your profile) counts consecutive days you've played at all, in any mode — giving up still counts as playing, so it doesn't break this one. If you miss a day, Jack Frost can restore your global streak once every 60 days from your profile.
faq.a8: The filter panel lets you restrict the character pool to specific Persona entries — P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P5X, Persona Q and their sub-titles. Your selection is saved between sessions and applies across all 6 modes.
faq.q9: Do I need an account to play?
faq.a9: No. You can play anonymously — all progress is stored locally in your browser. Creating a free account unlocks cloud sync, friends, leaderboard rankings, challenges, and the Social Link system.
faq.a10: Yes. The game has a service worker that caches all assets. Sessions played offline are automatically synced to the server when you reconnect.
faq.q11: How do I transfer my progress to an account?
faq.a11: After signing up, go to your Profile and tap Migrate. Your local stats, streaks and unlocks will be imported. The migration is safe and can be run multiple times without duplicating data.
faq.a12: Yes! Join our community to chat with other fans, share your scores and follow development.
faq.q13: How do I report a bug or suggest a character?
faq.a13: Use the «Suggestions & Bug Report» link in the footer — it opens our GitHub issues. You can also join the Discord.
faq.q14: What is the Social Link system?
faq.a14: Inspired by the Persona games, Social Links track the bond between you and each friend. Mutual interactions (profile visits, challenges, stat comparisons) earn XP and raise your rank from 1 — Stranger to 10 — True Confidant. Reaching rank 10 unlocks a special golden halo effect.
faq.a15: PersonaDLE was created by Hamza. He was joined by talented contributors who helped shape the project:
faq.team_hamza_role: Founder & Lead Dev — game logic, backend, animations
faq.team_leo_role: Data & Design — character database, portraits, layouts
faq.team_dzulian_role: Creative Consultant — P1/P2 accuracy, classic trilogy expertise
faq.q16: Is PersonaDLE affiliated with Atlus or SEGA?
faq.a16: No. PersonaDLE is an independent, non-commercial fan project. All Persona characters, music and artwork belong to their respective rights holders (Atlus, SEGA). This is a love letter to the series — nothing more.
faq.q17: Why aren't there Persona 4 characters in All-Out Attack mode?
faq.a17: We don't have high-quality Golden-style All-Out Attack artwork for Persona 4 yet. They'll be added when Persona 4 Revival arrives.
faq.q18: Why can't I find Persona 1 Personas in Personae mode?
faq.a18: We don't have enough good-quality artwork for Persona 1's Personas yet to include them fairly.
faq.q19: Will you add other Atlus games like Metaphor or Shin Megami Tensei?
faq.a19: We're still thinking about it! For now PersonaDLE focuses on the Persona series.
faq.q20: Will the game be updated for Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6?
faq.a20: Of course! New characters and content will be added as these games release.
faq.q21: Does giving up break my streak?
faq.a21: It depends which streak (see "What is a streak?" above). Your global streak (profile page) keeps going — giving up still counts as playing that day. But giving up does break your per-mode streak for that mode, since it only counts consecutive daily wins.
faq.q22: Is the daily character the same for everyone?
faq.a22: No — each player gets their own daily character, so you can't simply copy a friend's answer.
faq.q23: How do I unlock wallpapers and badges?
faq.a23: By playing! They unlock automatically when you meet their conditions (wins, streaks, modes played, social actions). Unlocks are verified server-side.
faq.q24: How do I pin badges to my profile?
faq.a24: Open the Badges panel, click up to 4 unlocked badges to feature them, then press Save. Your selection syncs to your account.
faq.a25: Titles unlock by reaching stat milestones (wins, streaks...). Equip one from your profile to show it under your pseudo.
faq.q26: What is the Social Link and how do I raise it?
faq.a26: Social Links measure your bond with each friend (rank 1-10). XP is earned automatically by spending time together — visiting profiles, comparing stats, challenges, playing the same day. Mutual actions give double XP.
faq.a27: Yes, from your profile — unless an admin has locked it (e.g. after a moderation issue).
faq.q28: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.a28: From your profile settings. Your account is anonymized immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days, in line with GDPR.
faq.a29: Send a friend a challenge in a specific mode; they play the same target and you compare results. It also earns Social Link XP.
faq.q30: How do I report a bug or suggest a character?
faq.a30: Use the «Suggestions & Bug Report» link in the footer — it opens our GitHub issues. You can also join the Discord.
faq.a31: The code is on GitHub under the MIT license. Game assets (characters, art, music) belong to Atlus/SEGA and are used non-commercially.
faq.q32: Can I contribute to the code?
faq.a32: Yes! Open an issue or a pull request on GitHub. See CONTRIBUTING.md to get started.
faq.q33: How do I change the language or enable colorblind mode?
faq.a33: In Settings (gear icon): pick from 5 languages and toggle dark mode or colorblind-friendly colors.
faq.q34: Are my data synced across devices?
faq.a34: Yes — with an account, your progress, stats and profile sync automatically. Without one, progress is saved only on that device.

updates.new_content_desc: New characters, new music — everything added in this update.
updates.summer_intro: ☀️ Summer 2026 is officially here — and the beach just got dangerous. Wonder, Closer & Moko traded their combat gear for swimwear, and honestly? They still hit just as hard. Celebrate the season with these scorching new All-Out Attack summer skins. You've been warned. 🏖️🔥
updates.intro_css: 🎨 CSS went from one giant bloated file to a clean per-mode architecture. Dark mode actually works properly now. Responsive layout doesn't cry on mobile anymore. A quiet revolution nobody asked for — and everyone needed.
updates.intro_i18n: 🌐 From hardcoded French strings scattered everywhere to a proper 5-language system with 760+ keys, auto-detection, and fallbacks. No more broken text when you switch to German at midnight.
updates.intro_js: ⚙️ The codebase was a spaghetti bowl of copy-pasted logic. Now it's modular, testable, and maintainable. `gameCore.js` is the single source of truth. It only took a few hundred commits to get here.
updates.intro_filters: 🔍 Filters used to stack listeners like pancakes and break everything silently. Now they're shared, persistent, and actually respect the challenge scope. No more phantom filter bugs.
updates.intro_music: 🎵 Music mode got a fully custom P5-styled audio player, dynamic color themes per series, and 13 brand new tracks. Your ears will thank you. Your playlists won't.
updates.intro_backend: 🗄️ 20 tables, PHP 8.3, MariaDB 10.6+, REST API, offline-first sync. The infrastructure that makes everything else possible — built from scratch, secured, and deployed. No shortcuts.
updates.intro_social: 👥 Friends, Social Links, challenges, notifications, and rank-up animations — the full Persona social experience, built in vanilla JS and PHP. True Confidant rank still hits different.
updates.intro_leaderboard: 🏆 Weekly, monthly, all-time. By mode, by metric. Global or friends-only. Your rank is always visible. Try to pretend it doesn't matter — we both know it does.
updates.intro_titles: 🎖️ 60+ badges, server-side unlock verification, event codes, 4 rarity tiers. Equip a title under your pseudo. Flex responsibly. Or don't — Legendary titles weren't earned to stay hidden.
updates.intro_profile: 🖼️ Avatar canvas cropper, wallpapers, profile music, sharing card — the full vanity package. Export your profile as a PNG and flex on Discord. With 8 themes and 25 wallpapers, there's no excuse for a boring profile.
updates.intro_admin: 🛡️ Ban, lock, manage event codes, monitor stats. The admin panel does everything except make coffee. It also has a full audit trail, so no one can pretend they didn't do the thing they definitely did.
updates.intro_cicd: 🚀 GitHub Actions, git hooks, Service Worker, Hostinger crons — the invisible machinery that keeps everything running. It only pages you at 3am when something actually breaks. Usually.
updates.intro_security: 🔒 CORS, PDO, bcrypt, rate limiting, 7 vulnerabilities patched. The kind of stuff that's invisible when it works and catastrophic when it doesn't. It works.
updates.intro_tests: 🧪 242 unit tests, all green. Every new utility in `gameCore.js` ships with tests. Prettier keeps diffs clean. The pre-commit hook won't let you ship broken i18n. Trust the pipeline.
updates.intro_bugfixes: 🐛 Listener stacking, DST edge cases, race conditions, CORS wildcards, silent 409s — if it could break quietly, it has been fixed. Accessibility improvements included, because 'broken' isn't just for bugs.
updates.joker_starlight_intro: The Phantom Thief trades his signature coat for a tailored suit — Joker's Dancing in Starlight variant joins P5X with a brand new All-Out Attack animation and a touch of elegance.
